scope: Fixed directed exact Feature parameters under Behavior/Step-compatible owners; selectors and shared positional default/generalization integration. Not complete parameter semantics or actual-library qualification.

imported.owner_predicate: Existing resolved parameter-collection predicate and imported Ecore ancestry establish owning Behavior/Step and directed Feature.
imported.default_selector: Existing generated ordinary Feature selector; parameter flags select the same resolved branch. No new per-owner hardcoded default names.
imported.positional_strategy: Existing thirty-binding resolved parameter collection and redefinition algorithms.
imported.canonical_model: Imported reference contracts and ownership attach FeatureValue/Expression, FeatureMembership/ParameterMembership, Specialization and Redefinition.

native_consumption.handwritten_context_policy: Admit exact Feature, a valid direction, canonical parameter-compatible containment, and fixed non-end/nonvariable/noncomposite/nonportion flags. Return parameters use their existing separately assessed provider.
native_consumption.shared_queries: Read-only default/general-type queries consume the generated predicate/selector plus existing ordered positional redefinitions. Preserve explicit relationships and assess generated implied redefinitions without completion flags.
native_consumption.typed_dependencies: Owner additional-member construction and registered pending owner generalization fields propagate before entering the existing complete-snapshot positional API. No unresolved field is silently replaced by an empty result.
native_consumption.physical_contributions: Existing shared implicit reduction and atomic canonical specialization insertion preserve only necessary defaults/redefinitions; inherited Base::things removes a redundant direct default. Persistence and unchanged replay reuse the same consumers.
native_consumption.valuations: Preserve one canonical Expression per admitted nonimplied FeatureValue. Directed FeatureAdapter inputs do not acquire bound-value Subsetting. Expression evaluation/transformation remains separate.
